itemListElement.name: 🦕☕️ Dinosaurs in Houston? What We Ordered: Cambrian Coffee - Spring Branch #houstoneats
itemListElement.description:
Looking for the best coffee shop in Spring Branch, Houston? Cambrian was celebrating their 5 year anniversary with so we joined in on the fun, a dino themed specialty coffee shop in the heart of Spring Branch. If you’re wondering what to order at Cambrian Coffee, here’s exactly what we had with tasting notes.

White Chocolate Cherry Latte 🍒☕️ Smooth and dessert like with creamy white chocolate, a bright cherry pop, and a cozy espresso finish with cherry and vanilla cream vibes.
Cranberry Basil Refresher 🌿🍓 Tart cranberry up front, lightly sweet, and finished with a fresh basil herbal note that makes it crisp and refreshing.
Blueberry Mini Loaf 🫐🍞 Soft buttery crumb with juicy blueberry bursts and a bakery fresh sweetness that pairs perfectly with coffee.

Sara has been coming to Cambrian Coffee since they opened, and last year we even hosted conversations there, which made this anniversary visit extra meaningful. Cambrian has become one of those neighborhood spots that feels welcoming, local, and full of community.

Located in the heart of the Spring Branch neighborhood of Houston, Cambrian Coffee offers up the finest specialty coffee and fresh baked goods in the area. Proprietors Brian and Gemma live in Spring Shadows and are dedicated to helping promote growth in the area while offering a social space for locals to meet and carry out constructive conversation. Gemma is the heart of the baking operation, crafting delicious British inspired baked goods from signature sausage rolls to scones, mini loaves, and cookies.

Cambrian offers a large selection of hot and iced coffee drinks made with house made syrups. Sample a classic cappuccino or latte from the espresso bar or treat yourself to matcha or nitro cold brew. Grab one of the bottled drinks like the Cambrian Latte with house honey cinnamon syrup or a Vanilla Oatmilk Matcha, all made in house. Experience Cambrian’s famous sausage rolls, the classic British recipe served daily until they sell out, plus a weekly rotating special sausage roll like Jalapeno Cheese, Maple Chili, Smoky Chipotle, and more.

itemListElement.name: Adair Kitchen Houston Food Review - Best Dishes To Try: Hummus, Grilled Chicken, Basque Cheesecake
itemListElement.description:
Looking for what to order at Adair Kitchen in Houston? We met up with a friend for an EatDrinkHTX dinner and tried a full spread—fresh, bright flavors with a few rich, smoky surprises.

What we ordered + flavor notes:
🥙 Hummus + roasted wild mushrooms — creamy hummus with earthy, savory mushrooms. The garlic tahini adds a bold, nutty punch, and the pomegranate brings a sweet-tart pop that cuts through the richness. Served with grilled bread.

🥪 Veggie Stack Sandwich — super flavorful and herby: grilled zucchini, roasted peppers, and mushrooms tossed in pesto (garlicky + basil-forward), with peppery arugula and red onion for crunch. Melted Swiss makes it smooth and creamy, all on toasted sourdough. Comes with house chips.

🍗 Grilled Half Chicken with salsa macha — juicy, char-grilled chicken topped with salsa macha (smoky, spicy, and a little nutty/roasty). The cilantro rice keeps it fresh and bright, and pickled onions add that tangy bite.

🌯 Simple Green Chicken Enchiladas — comforting and savory with a fresh, slightly tangy green sauce. Tender chicken, creamy refried black beans, cilantro rice, and avocado make it rich but still balanced.

🍰 Basque Cheesecake — caramelized top with a creamy center. The orange marmalade adds citrus sweetness, toasted hazelnuts give crunch, and the brown butter + sea salt brings a warm, salty-sweet finish.

Save this for your next Houston restaurant visit—especially if you’re eating at Adair Kitchen (San Felipe).

itemListElement.name: 🦕☕️ Dinosaurs in Houston? What We Ordered: Cambrian Coffee - Spring Branch #houstoneats
itemListElement.description:
Looking for the best coffee shop in Spring Branch, Houston? Cambrian was celebrating their 5 year anniversary with so we joined in on the fun, a dino themed specialty coffee shop in the heart of Spring Branch. If you’re wondering what to order at Cambrian Coffee, here’s exactly what we had with tasting notes.

White Chocolate Cherry Latte 🍒☕️ Smooth and dessert like with creamy white chocolate, a bright cherry pop, and a cozy espresso finish with cherry and vanilla cream vibes.
Cranberry Basil Refresher 🌿🍓 Tart cranberry up front, lightly sweet, and finished with a fresh basil herbal note that makes it crisp and refreshing.
Blueberry Mini Loaf 🫐🍞 Soft buttery crumb with juicy blueberry bursts and a bakery fresh sweetness that pairs perfectly with coffee.

Sara has been coming to Cambrian Coffee since they opened, and last year we even hosted conversations there, which made this anniversary visit extra meaningful. Cambrian has become one of those neighborhood spots that feels welcoming, local, and full of community.

Located in the heart of the Spring Branch neighborhood of Houston, Cambrian Coffee offers up the finest specialty coffee and fresh baked goods in the area. Proprietors Brian and Gemma live in Spring Shadows and are dedicated to helping promote growth in the area while offering a social space for locals to meet and carry out constructive conversation. Gemma is the heart of the baking operation, crafting delicious British inspired baked goods from signature sausage rolls to scones, mini loaves, and cookies.

Cambrian offers a large selection of hot and iced coffee drinks made with house made syrups. Sample a classic cappuccino or latte from the espresso bar or treat yourself to matcha or nitro cold brew. Grab one of the bottled drinks like the Cambrian Latte with house honey cinnamon syrup or a Vanilla Oatmilk Matcha, all made in house. Experience Cambrian’s famous sausage rolls, the classic British recipe served daily until they sell out, plus a weekly rotating special sausage roll like Jalapeno Cheese, Maple Chili, Smoky Chipotle, and more.

We stopped by French Riviera Bakery Cafe in Houston near Chimney Rock in the Uptown Galleria area for a cozy brunch experience.

The toasted croissant chicken salad sandwich had a perfectly flaky buttery croissant with a creamy well seasoned chicken salad that tasted fresh and balanced. The caramelized mushroom and onion quiche was rich and savory with deep caramelized flavor and a soft custardy center. We paired everything with a smooth cappuccino that was warm, balanced, and comforting.

This spot is easy to find near Chimney Rock in the Uptown Houston Galleria area and it is a great place to bring family for breakfast or brunch. After eating you can browse their beautiful selection of home goods inside the bakery, and right next door you can even shop for plants, which makes the visit even more fun.

itemListElement.name: Adair Kitchen Houston Food Review - Best Dishes To Try: Hummus, Grilled Chicken, Basque Cheesecake
itemListElement.description:
Looking for what to order at Adair Kitchen in Houston? We met up with a friend for an EatDrinkHTX dinner and tried a full spread—fresh, bright flavors with a few rich, smoky surprises.

What we ordered + flavor notes:
🥙 Hummus + roasted wild mushrooms — creamy hummus with earthy, savory mushrooms. The garlic tahini adds a bold, nutty punch, and the pomegranate brings a sweet-tart pop that cuts through the richness. Served with grilled bread.

🥪 Veggie Stack Sandwich — super flavorful and herby: grilled zucchini, roasted peppers, and mushrooms tossed in pesto (garlicky + basil-forward), with peppery arugula and red onion for crunch. Melted Swiss makes it smooth and creamy, all on toasted sourdough. Comes with house chips.

🍗 Grilled Half Chicken with salsa macha — juicy, char-grilled chicken topped with salsa macha (smoky, spicy, and a little nutty/roasty). The cilantro rice keeps it fresh and bright, and pickled onions add that tangy bite.

🌯 Simple Green Chicken Enchiladas — comforting and savory with a fresh, slightly tangy green sauce. Tender chicken, creamy refried black beans, cilantro rice, and avocado make it rich but still balanced.

🍰 Basque Cheesecake — caramelized top with a creamy center. The orange marmalade adds citrus sweetness, toasted hazelnuts give crunch, and the brown butter + sea salt brings a warm, salty-sweet finish.

Save this for your next Houston restaurant visit—especially if you’re eating at Adair Kitchen (San Felipe).

#AdairKitchen #HoustonFood #HoustonRestaurants #EatDrinkHTX #HTXEats #HoustonFoodie #FoodReview #WhatToOrder

itemListElement.name: 🦕☕️ Dinosaurs in Houston? What We Ordered: Cambrian Coffee - Spring Branch #houstoneats
itemListElement.description:
Looking for the best coffee shop in Spring Branch, Houston? Cambrian was celebrating their 5 year anniversary with so we joined in on the fun, a dino themed specialty coffee shop in the heart of Spring Branch. If you’re wondering what to order at Cambrian Coffee, here’s exactly what we had with tasting notes.

White Chocolate Cherry Latte 🍒☕️ Smooth and dessert like with creamy white chocolate, a bright cherry pop, and a cozy espresso finish with cherry and vanilla cream vibes.
Cranberry Basil Refresher 🌿🍓 Tart cranberry up front, lightly sweet, and finished with a fresh basil herbal note that makes it crisp and refreshing.
Blueberry Mini Loaf 🫐🍞 Soft buttery crumb with juicy blueberry bursts and a bakery fresh sweetness that pairs perfectly with coffee.

Sara has been coming to Cambrian Coffee since they opened, and last year we even hosted conversations there, which made this anniversary visit extra meaningful. Cambrian has become one of those neighborhood spots that feels welcoming, local, and full of community.

Located in the heart of the Spring Branch neighborhood of Houston, Cambrian Coffee offers up the finest specialty coffee and fresh baked goods in the area. Proprietors Brian and Gemma live in Spring Shadows and are dedicated to helping promote growth in the area while offering a social space for locals to meet and carry out constructive conversation. Gemma is the heart of the baking operation, crafting delicious British inspired baked goods from signature sausage rolls to scones, mini loaves, and cookies.

Cambrian offers a large selection of hot and iced coffee drinks made with house made syrups. Sample a classic cappuccino or latte from the espresso bar or treat yourself to matcha or nitro cold brew. Grab one of the bottled drinks like the Cambrian Latte with house honey cinnamon syrup or a Vanilla Oatmilk Matcha, all made in house. Experience Cambrian’s famous sausage rolls, the classic British recipe served daily until they sell out, plus a weekly rotating special sausage roll like Jalapeno Cheese, Maple Chili, Smoky Chipotle, and more.

itemListElement.name: Best French Cafe in Houston Galleria? 🇫🇷 French Riviera Bakery Cafe Review: Croissant & Quiche
itemListElement.description:
In this video we visit French Riviera Bakery Cafe in Houston near Chimney Rock in the Uptown Galleria area to try one of the most talked about French bakery brunch spots in the city.

We ordered the toasted croissant chicken salad sandwich, the caramelized mushroom and onion quiche, and a cappuccino to get the full experience.

The croissant sandwich stands out with its flaky buttery texture and a creamy well seasoned chicken salad that tastes fresh and balanced without being too heavy. The quiche delivers a rich savory flavor with perfectly caramelized mushrooms and onions, paired with a soft custardy center that feels authentic to a classic French bakery. The cappuccino is smooth and comforting, tying everything together for a relaxing brunch.

This location is easy to access near Chimney Rock in the Uptown Houston Galleria area, making it a convenient stop whether you live nearby or are visiting. It is also a great place to bring family for a casual breakfast or brunch outing.

One unique part of this bakery cafe is the experience beyond the food. After your meal you can browse their curated selection of home goods inside the cafe, and right next door you can explore a plant shop, making it a perfect slow morning or weekend stop in Houston.

If you are searching for a French bakery cafe in Houston with great croissants, quiche, coffee, and a welcoming atmosphere, French Riviera Bakery Cafe is definitely worth adding to your list.

Cambrian offers a large selection of hot and iced coffee drinks made with house made syrups. Sample a classic cappuccino or latte from the espresso bar or treat yourself to matcha or nitro cold brew. Grab one of the bottled drinks like the Cambrian Latte with house honey cinnamon syrup or a Vanilla Oatmilk Matcha, all made in house. Experience Cambrian’s famous sausage rolls, the classic British recipe served daily until they sell out, plus a weekly rotating special sausage roll like Jalapeno Cheese, Maple Chili, Smoky Chipotle, and more.

Import1.review: A Sweet Factory in Houston is a dessert gem! Love the Mediterranean pastries, kanafeh is my favorite, a bright orange, cheesy delight with oozing mozzarella and akawi, topped with sweet syrup when warmed.
Import1.description: A Sweet Factory, a hidden spot in Houston on Westheimer Road, serves gooey kanafeh and fragrant Arabian pastries.
Import1.title: A Sweet Factory

Import1.review: I stumbled upon a potato cookbook at Berings which will be perfect for bébé and I. Gotta love a good and hearty potato recipe, especially with cozy autumn around the corner.
Import1.description: Bering’s is the kind of Houston staple that makes browsing feel like an adventure, warm, whimsical, and full of treasures across every aisle.
Import1.category: Cards & Stationery, Furniture Stores, Hardware Stores
Import1.title: Bering’s

Import1.review: Glad Crescent City Beignets relocated instead of closing! The new Westheimer spot is in a small, lively plaza, though parking’s tight, I parked at the next plaza over on a busy Friday night.
Import1.description: Crescent City Beignets, now on Westheimer Road in Houston, serves classic beignets in a lively plaza. Friendly staff and a vibrant vibe make it great for out of town guests.
Import1.title: Crescent City Beignets

Import1.review: Droubi’s Bakery & Deli in Houston is a gem for chicken shawarma! The juicy, succulent chicken with tangy, garlicky yogurt sauce and slivers of pickles is perfection, I love the tartness!
Import1.description: Droubi’s Bakery & Deli, a flavorful spot in Houston on Hillcroft Street, serves juicy chicken shawarma and buttery mamoul pastries.
Import1.title: Droubi’s Bakery & Deli

Import1.review: Dunkin’ serves up some decent hot coffee, always crisp and tasty. Whether hot or iced, it’s a good alternative to the usual Starbucks run.
Import1.description: Dunkin’ in Westchase delivers what it’s best known for: quick, reliable coffee and convenient drive thru service.
Import1.title: Dunkin’

Import1.review: Fadi’s Mediterranean Grill in Houston is a Levantine gem! The fresh, warm food has distinct flavors, every dish is amazing! Piled my plate with side dishes yesterday, and each was wonderfully delicious.
Import1.description: Fadi’s Mediterranean Grill, a beloved spot in Houston on Westheimer Road, serves fresh Levantine dishes with warm pita bread.
Import1.title: Fadi’s Mediterranean Grill

Import1.review: A gem of a coffee roaster headquartered in Gulfton, near Chimney Rock. It’s a bit difficult to find, just a row of plain office buildings, but that adds to the adventure of locating this coffee lab.
Import1.description: Tucked inside a row of unassuming office style buildings near Chimney Rock, Java Pura is one of Houston’s most meaningful hidden gems. This isn’t a café, it’s a working roastery, a coffee lab, and a hub for true bean obsessives.
Import1.title: Java Pura Coffee Roasters

Import1.review: Kabob Korner in Houston was bustling at lunchtime, and I regret not trying the Pakistani dishes everyone raved about! I was mall bound, so I wanted a filling meal.
Import1.description: Kabob Korner, a bustling spot in Houston on Hillcroft Avenue, serves chicken shawarma and Pakistani chai.
Import1.title: Kabob Korner

Import1.review: I thought this spot was just alright. What a hype. Location wise, it is not the easiest to spot, tucked away in a corner of an area that is typically not frequented. In regards to customer service?
Import1.description: La Argentina Gelato & Coffee is a small, tucked away spot offering South American, style gelato and baked treats. While its reputation has generated quite a bit of buzz, this particular visit left room for improvement.
Import1.title: La Argentina Gelato & Coffee

Import1.review: Lopez Mexican Restaurant in Houston was just okay, nothing spectacular. I ordered the shrimp fajitas, but they were rubbery and overcooked, not great.
Import1.description: Lopez Mexican Restaurant, a spacious spot in Houston on Wilcrest Drive, serves shrimp fajitas with classic beans and rice.
Import1.title: Lopez Mexican Restaurant

Import1.review: They say dairy does the body good. But I'm not too sure about that. Sometimes over doing it with milk tea leaves ya' belly bloated and hankering for something lighter. Most of these milk teas are questionable as well.

Import1.description: Explore Afghan flavors at The Afghan Village in Houston’s Gulfton area on Hillcroft Street, offering dishes like mantoo and Uzbaki rice.
Import1.title: The Afghan Village

Import1.review: Ahh! I'm a big fan of sorbet… and this place totally satisfied my craving for all things sorbet related. Amorino serves authentic gelato, waffles, chocolates, coffee beverages, and even pound cakes and macarons.
Import1.description: Amorino brings a touch of European indulgence to Highland Village, offering artisanal gelato and sorbet crafted with premium ingredients, many imported from around the world.
Import1.category: Gelato, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Macarons
Import1.title: Amorino Gelato

Import1.review: I had the chance to try out Bayou City Seafood & Pasta earlier this week. Came here to have dinner with friends on a chilly Monday night. The outside of the restaurant looks quite shabby like a barbeque restaurant.
Import1.description: Dive into the bold flavors of Bayou City Seafood and Pasta, a casual Highland Village spot that brings Cajun and Creole vibes to Houston.
Import1.title: Bayou City Seafood and Pasta

Import1.review: Oh Sprinkles, Your cupcakes have become drier than a boring brick wall. What happened? Within the span of two months I have visited twice.
Import1.description: Sprinkles Houston Westheimer in Highland Village is a beloved dessert destination, known for its iconic cupcakes and 24/7 ATM cupcake machine.
Import1.title: Sprinkles Houston Westheimer

Import1.review: George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) is the worst! I was stuck for hours due to a delayed flight, then the airline canceled it, how does that make sense?
Import1.description: George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) in the IAH Airport Area on JFK Boulevard is a major hub, but flight delays and outdated facilities can frustrate.
Import1.title: George Bush Intercontinental Airport - IAH

Import1.review: Nom Mi Street in Houston’s MacGregor is the cutest, most colorful food truck! Got a vegetarian banh mi with fried tofu, veggies, and cilantro, toasty and flavorful, though the tofu was a bit too fried for me.
Import1.description: Nom Mi Street, a colorful food truck in Houston’s MacGregor near the University of Houston, serves toasty vegetarian banh mi and fusion fries.
Import1.title: Nom Mi Street

Import1.review: I had a craving for some chicken.. but not any kind of chicken. But a good and juicy one.. that had been marinating for 24 hours and slowly cooking over charcoal. I found what I was looking for here at Chicken Station.
Import1.description: Savor juicy, charcoal cooked chicken at Chicken Station in Houston’s Magnolia Park, a casual East End spot serving Peruvian style dishes with crispy yucca and sweet plantains.
Import1.title: Chicken Station

Import1.review: Wow, stellar street food at Gyro King! The New York native owners bring that Big Apple vibe, I felt transported back to NYC’s yellow street carts. Craved chicken and rice with white sauce, and Gyro King delivered!
Import1.description: Gyro King, a bright yellow food truck near Houston’s Medical Center on South Main Street, serves juicy chicken and rice with creamy white sauce.
Import1.category: Food Trucks, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Halal
Import1.title: Gyro King

Import1.review: It was my first time ever visiting the Rodeo. I knew it really wasn’t my thing and boy was I correct. My friends and I visited over the weekend on a Sunday afternoon. It happened to be a cool and cloudy day. Thankfully.
Import1.description: Saddle up for the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo in the Medical Center, a iconic Houston event with petting zoos, carnival rides, and boutique shopping.
Import1.title: Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo

Import1.review: M&M Grill in Houston’s Medical Center is a family favorite! This shabby chic hole in the wall has limited seating and red walls, giving Rockets basketball vibes, kids were even watching a game!
Import1.description: M&M Grill, a casual spot in Houston’s Medical Center on Fannin Street, serves moist chicken soft tacos and cheesy enchiladas.
Import1.title: M&M Grill

Import1.review: Koryo Bakery in Memorial had a strong, strange smell when I walked in, not the cozy vanilla or butter vibe I expected.
Import1.description: Koryo Bakery in Houston’s Memorial on Gessner Road offers mini cakes, breads, and almond cakes. A local Houston spot for pastry enthusiasts.
Import1.title: Koryo Bakery

Import1.review: LA Crawfish, no, not Los Angeles, y’all. This is all about Louisiana style grub. The food here is coated with spice and heavy handed with salt and oil, but that’s typically the palate of Cajun/crawfish cuisine.
Import1.description: LA Crawfish in Memorial brings a lively blend of Cajun heat and Vietnamese comfort food to one tucked away corner inside 99 Ranch Market.
Import1.title: LA Crawfish

Import1.review: Donuts were old and cold. Greasy and stale upon holding the darn donut. Although known to be 24 hrs, this location totally does not serve warm nor fresh donuts.
Import1.description: Satisfy your donut cravings at Shipley Do Nuts in Houston’s Memorial area, a 24 hour spot conveniently located off the freeway.
Import1.title: Shipley Do-Nuts
